desc: Implement the convex hull sweep algorithm in Python with a deque, using cross multiplication for hull maintenance and for popping from the front when a better left point is found.
Keep track of the maximum y-intercept as a fraction (numerator, denominator) to avoid floating point errors.
After processing, decide output: if max numerator < 0, print -1; if max numerator == 0, print 0.0; else print the decimal value of the fraction.
Test the implementation on the provided sample inputs to verify correctness.
